You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.

2174-4222-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
2174-4222-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.

2921-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
2921-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2527-2842-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-2842-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4311-5078-5295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1731-2105-3337.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
1731-2105-3337.notablePrerequisites: Tanuki Transplanter or the creature it is attached to can attack without taking damage.
1731-2105-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Tanuki Transplanter and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Tanuki Transplanter and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Tanuki Transplanter's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.

3899-5617-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2382-3899-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-3899-5659--33.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-6094-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1368-6006-6321-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6006-6321-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4050-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
4050-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

4186-4384-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-6823.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7330.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2440-2703-7292.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

1765-5256-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-5256-5972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4200-4681-5147.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3110-5173-5553-5626.easyPrerequisites: "Chthonian Nightmare" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

851-5448-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5448-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

57-647-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-647-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-4693-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-3518-4404.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

549-856-6748-6757-6798.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1318-2743-5134.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Fated Infatuation twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Fated Infatuation spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary and causing you to scry 2 three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

826-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2732-6132.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger,
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prowling Geistcatcher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 6, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1651-3715-5365-6441.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-6441.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

1651-2043-4365-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing the Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

1479-4288-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4288-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2510-5078-5642.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

974-1995-2157.easyPrerequisites: Gauntlets of Light attached to Romana II.
974-1995-2157.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1995-2157.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Romana II.
Repeat from step 3.

81-3076-4116.notablePrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Sleep-Cursed Faerie each have a counter on them.
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
81-3076-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, turning Volrath into a 7/5 copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Volrath using Kami of Whispered Hope's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, turning it into a copy of Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
Activate Volrath using Sleep-Cursed Faerie's ability by paying {1}{U},  untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {U}, repeat the combo for mana of any color.

3101-4867-5487.notablePrerequisites: You have an amount of mana available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-4867-5487.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-1069-1374-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
969-1069-1374-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1267-4962-5459.manaNeeded: {2} available the first turn, and {4} each extra turn
1267-4962-5459.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures, one of which does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1267-4962-5459.description:
Declare a creature you control that cannot be blocked by an opponent as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Assimilation Aegis' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the creature.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage with the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Assimilation Aegis' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Repeat.

156-5342.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
156-5342.description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves kicked by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Scourge of the Skyclaves triggers, causing you to lose half your life total, and then causing each opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

331-1063-1633-2060-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

224-2085-2653-4967.notablePrerequisites: Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
224-2085-2653-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

3008-3048-3197-5296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3008-3048-3197-5296.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth and Workhorse.
Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Workhorse twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1133-1258-3518-5112.description:
During your upkeep, activate Mairsil by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Mairsil dies, triggering Abduction, returning Mairsil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Repeat.

1167-2047-4600.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver.
Activate the token Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1628-3197-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature, milling target player equal to its power.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Beast token, milling target player four.
Repeat from step 2.

3462-4808-4986.description:
Activate Black Lotus, sacrificing it to add {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Salvage Scout, sacrificing it to return Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Black Lotus, triggering Teshar.
Resolve the Teshar trigger, returning Salvage Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
